column1: Bobby Witt Jr. stands out as the top pick, hitting safely in nearly 75% of games and enjoying a strong recent stretch at home with the platoon advantage against Matthew Boyd. Jake McCarthy offers similar reliability atop the order and also benefits from a favorable matchup, making him a solid secondary choice. Luis Arraez brings elite contact skills and a high rate of games with a hit, while Alec Burleson and Elly De La Cruz round out the top options for Beat The Streak players.
